# Is Gemini down?

Updated November 25, 2026 · an explainer, not a live status page

**This page can't tell you whether Gemini is down right now**: it is a static page. The answer is on Google's official status page:

- [Google Workspace Status Dashboard (the Gemini app)](https://www.google.com/appsstatus/dashboard/)

- [Google AI Studio status (the Gemini API)](https://aistudio.google.com/status)

Google reports the Gemini app on the Google Workspace Status Dashboard, and the Gemini API on Google AI Studio's status page.

## If the status page says everything is fine

Then the problem is probably closer to you. In order, try:

1. Another network: switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data, or turn off a VPN.

2. Signing out and in again, or closing and reopening the Gemini app.

3. Updating the app, or trying Gemini on the web from another device.

4. A shorter message: a very long conversation or file can fail when a short one works.

5. Waiting a few minutes: many problems are short and don't reach the status page.

## If Gemini is down

An outage usually affects one maker at a time. Another maker's model can carry on in the meantime: in Omnimo you can switch from Gemini to GPT-6, Claude, Grok or DeepSeek in the same chat, and on supported devices Apple Intelligence answers on the device with no internet at all.

To be clear about what this does and doesn't fix: Omnimo reaches Google's models through an API. When Google's API is down, Gemini in Omnimo can be down too; the other makers' models are not affected. When only the Gemini app or website is down, the API often still works. [Gemini in Omnimo](https://www.privateslm.dev/models/gemini.html).

## Questions

### How do I know if Gemini is down?

Check Google's official status page, listed on this page. It shows current incidents for Gemini and its API.

### What can I use while Gemini is down?

Another maker's model. In Omnimo you can switch to GPT-6, Claude, Grok or DeepSeek in the same chat; on a device with Apple Intelligence, it answers on the device without the internet.
